| # VSS_3 (sensor supply 3) {#vss_3-sensor-supply-3-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the sensor supply voltage 3.

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- The VSS_3 voltage can be queried using bds_sys_aiv().

- In case of short circuit to ground and short circuit to battery the sensor supply will be switched-off.

- If error is recovered then switch-on of sensor supply is possible only after 1000ms.

- To switch-on the sensor supply after the error recovery use the bds_sys_setVSS().

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 5.250V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 4.750V

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

- Over Voltage Error  ( VSS_3  \>= Over Voltage Error Limit )

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OV_VSS3
  Error Code                     0x080500
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  bds_sys_setVSS(\...,OFF)       yes
  Reaction time                  80ms

 

- Under Voltage Error ( VSS3 \<= Under Voltage Error Limit )

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VSS3
  Error Code                     0x080600
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  bds_sys_setVSS(\...,OFF)       yes
  Reaction time                  80ms
